Name: Recovery: Family Compass on <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation>
MissionBoardDescription: Raiders took the hold of a freighter carrying our belongings, and are holding it at the <Alias=TargetLocation> on <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation>. Keep whatever else you find. We want one thing back, a brass compass. Return it to us in <Alias=FinalLocation>. Payment on contract completion.

LogEntries.Entry: Raiders hit a freighter carrying a family's belongings to <Alias=FinalLocation> and took the hold to the <Alias=TargetLocation>. The family only wants one thing back: a brass compass that came from Earth.
The raiders' leader at the <Alias=TargetLocation> is dead. The family's compass will be with whatever they took off the freighter.
I found the family's brass compass in the raiders' takings at the <Alias=TargetLocation>. It goes back to them in <Alias=FinalLocation>.
Raiders took a family's belongings to the <Alias=TargetLocation>. I went in and brought back the one thing they wanted, a brass compass their great-grandmother carried from Earth.

Objectives.DisplayText: Defeat the raiders' leader at the <Alias=TargetLocation>
Find the compass in the raiders' takings
Return the compass to the family in <Alias=FinalLocation>

Lines.ResponseText: You took our posting? The raiders who hit our freighter took everything we own. Did they still have the compass?
That's it. That's the dent from when my mother dropped it on a landing pad. I'd stopped telling the children it would come back.
Why this and not the rest?
The rest was furniture. You can buy furniture. This came from Earth. My grandmother's grandmother carried it on one of the first ships out, and it's been in somebody's pocket ever since.
It points north. Which north, on a planet that isn't Earth, nobody in this family has ever agreed on.
Sorry, we've only just moved in. Everything's still in boxes.
You took our posting? Then you're nearly at the site. They'll have kept the compass with the rest of what they took. It's old, it's brass, and it's the only thing we want back.
If they're dealt with, it'll be in with everything they took off us. Please look carefully, it's small.
